## What

> What sample are you proposing? What API or feature would it demonstrate?

## Why

> What problem does it solve, or what would a developer learn by reading this sample?

## Suggested scope

> Which API(s) would the sample exercise? Which top-level directory should it live under: `JavaDevelopmentKitSamples/`, `NativeDevelopmentKitSamples/`, `SupportLibrarySamples/`, or `MixedSdkSamples/`?

## Additional context

> Links to related platform docs, prior art, or upstream issues.
